scope: Fresh visual review of eleven changed learner pages after bounded heading-reserve repairs: Unit 5 pp13–18 and Unit 7 pp28–32.
independence: Reviewer did not author the TeX repairs or the learner masters.
method: Each full replacement page actually opened via view_image at original resolution from its new 150 dpi image; acceptance was not inferred from logs, text extraction, hashes, or thumbnails.

hash_verification.method: Current file bytes hashed with SHA-256 and compared to the exact heading-fix manifest entries used for inspection.

limits: This supplementary report covers only the eleven changed images. All other rerendered pages were centrally verified as byte-identical to initially accepted images; that identity audit is not represented here as fresh visual inspection. Initial review files remain unchanged.
